title: Gauss–Bonnet benchmark and stability must agree with one fixed action
assumptions: Printed sources are preserved; repairs of continuity/Friedmann/tensor formulas are labelled reviewer-derived.
Fixed potential and coupling constants impose algebraic invariant relations among autonomous variables.
Gradient sign, scalar/tensor kinetic signs, subluminality and observed-path GW speed are separate requirements.
predictions: At z0=zc, A0/y0=lambda zc/2; both Fig.6 examples fail this exact source minimum condition.
Eq.(5.5) agrees algebraically with (1−8kappa²fddot)/(1−8kappa²Hfdot), despite malformed Eq.(5.2). Figure6(ii) still exceeds the printed subluminal tensor bound in the future.

Equilibrium families have neutral tangent modes; varying equilibrium EOS contours/hyperbolic P1 labels conflict with Table I plus Eq.(4.4)/Appendix A. Physical-submanifold and regular scalar-kinetic checks are required before implementing a stable branch.
